headlines.description: Carson Wentz threw for 222 yards and three touchdowns to help the Philadelphia Eagles beat the Carolina Panthers 28-23 on Thursday night to improve to an NFC-best 5-1.
headlines.shortLinkText: Carson Wentz throws 3 TD passes, Eagles beat Panthers 28-23

headlines.description: Jay Cutler threw a pair of touchdown passes, Cody Parkey kicked a pair of field goals and the Miami Dolphins rallied from a 17-0 halftime deficit to stun the Atlanta Falcons 20-17 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dolphins rally from 17-point deficit to stun Falcons 20-17

events.name: Green Bay Packers at Minnesota Vikings

headlines.description: Harrison Smith led Minnesota's defense in a thorough dismantling of Green Bay, as the Vikings knocked Packers QB Aaron Rodgers out of the game on Sunday with a broken collarbone during their 23-10 victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: With Rodgers out, Vikings cruise past Packers 23-10

events.name: Detroit Lions at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: RBs Mark Ingram and Alvin Kamara combined for 237 yards from scrimmage, and New Orleans took a 52-38 victory over the Detroit Lions on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Saints' big-play defense fuels wild 52-38 win over Lions

events.name: New England Patriots at New York Jets

headlines.description: Tom Brady set the NFL record for regular-season victories by a quarterback, getting his 187th as the New England Patriots held on for a 24-17 win over the New York Jets on Sunday to claim first place in the AFC East.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brady gets wins record, Patriots hold off Jets 24-17

headlines.description: Kirk Cousins threw for two touchdowns, ran for a score and also had an INT against his past -- and possibly -- future mentor Kyle Shanahan's winless San Francisco 49ers in a 26-24 victory on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cousins struggles as Redskins barely hold on to beat 49ers

headlines.description: Connor Barth kicked a 40-yard field goal with 2:08 left in overtime, and the Chicago Bears used a 167-yard rushing effort by Jordan Howard to beat the Baltimore Ravens 27-24 on Sunday.

Deshaun Watson threw for 225 yards and three touchdowns, becoming the first rookie in NFL history with at least three TD passes in three straight games, helping give the Houston Texans a 33-17 win over the Cleveland Browns on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Watson tosses 3 TDs as Texans beat Browns 33-17

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Arizona Cardinals

headlines.description: Adrian Peterson rushed for two touchdowns and 134 yards in an impressive Arizona debut and the Cardinals held off a furious second-half Tampa Bay rally to beat the Buccaneers 38-33 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Peterson scores twice as Cardinals hold off Bucs 38-33

events.name: Los Angeles Rams at Jacksonville Jaguars

headlines.description: Pharoh Cooper returned the opening kickoff 103 yards, one of two special teams touchdowns that helped the Los Angeles Rams beat the Jacksonville Jaguars 27-17 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rams score twice on special teams, beat Jaguars 27-17

events.name: Pittsburgh Steelers at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: Le'Veon Bell ran for 179 yards and a touchdown, Antonio Brown made an acrobatic touchdown catch in the fourth quarter and the Pittsburgh Steelers held on to beat the Kansas City Chiefs 19-13 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Steelers outlast Chiefs 19-13 to defeat NFL's last unbeaten

events.name: Los Angeles Chargers at Oakland Raiders

headlines.description: Nick Novak kicked a 32-yard field goal on the final play of the game and the Los Angeles Chargers took advantage of a key missed extra point by Giorgio Tavecchio to beat the Oakland Raiders 17-16 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Novak's late kick leads Chargers past  Raiders 17-16

events.name: New York Giants at Denver Broncos

headlines.description: Eli Manning ignored the loss of four wide receivers, and the reeling New York Giants capped a stormy week of injuries and infighting by stunning the Denver Broncos 23-10 on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Manning, Pierre-Paul and rest of Giants stun Broncos 23-10

headlines.description: Marcus Mariota threw a 53-yard touchdown pass to Taywan Taylor with 5:29 left , and the Tennessee Titans beat the Indianapolis Colts 36-22 on Monday night to snap an 11-game skid tied for the NFL's longest active losing streak against one team.
headlines.shortLinkText: Finally! Titans end 11-game skid to Colts with 36-22 win
